verdict.rationale: A runtime probe confirms a canonical llms.txt at askjo.ai/llms.txt, served keyless as text/plain. It explicitly tells agents to prefer it over scraping the site, and it documents surfaces, integrations, architecture, ZDR model routing and pricing. A machine-readable OpenAPI 3.1 spec is also publicly served, giving agents an extra structured entry point. Missing for 10: independent or community corroboration of agents actually using these docs, and agent-oriented guidance around the OpenAPI spec (no developer program or API key docs).
